cells.title: Monthly Total Net Expenses
cells.code:
WITH 
months AS (SELECT
  to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_label,
  (date_trunc('month', d))::date AS month_start,
  CAST(date_trunc('month', d) + '1 month - 1 day'::interval AS date) AS month_end
FROM generate_series('2026-08-01'::date, '2026-10-01'::date, '1 month'::interval) AS d),
monthly_expenses AS (SELECT
  m.month_label,
  m.month_start,
  COALESCE(sum(l.base_debit - l.base_credit), 0) AS net_expenses
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN ledger AS l ON l.account_type = 'EXPENSE'
  AND l.status = 'POSTED'
  AND l.date >= m.month_start
  AND l.date <= m.month_end
GROUP BY
  m.month_label,
  m.month_start
ORDER BY
  m.month_start)
SELECT
  month_label,
  net_expenses
FROM monthly_expenses

cells.title: Summary Statistics (3 Completed Months)
cells.code:
WITH 
months AS (SELECT
  to_char(d, 'YYYY-MM') AS month_label,
  (date_trunc('month', d))::date AS month_start,
  CAST(date_trunc('month', d) + '1 month - 1 day'::interval AS date) AS month_end
FROM generate_series('2026-08-01'::date, '2026-10-01'::date, '1 month'::interval) AS d),
monthly_expenses AS (SELECT
  m.month_label,
  m.month_start,
  COALESCE(sum(l.base_debit - l.base_credit), 0) AS net_expenses
FROM months AS m
LEFT JOIN ledger AS l ON l.account_type = 'EXPENSE'
  AND l.status = 'POSTED'
  AND l.date >= m.month_start
  AND l.date <= m.month_end
GROUP BY
  m.month_label,
  m.month_start
ORDER BY
  m.month_start)
SELECT
  round(avg(net_expenses), 2) AS mean_net_expenses,
  percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY net_expenses) AS median_net_expenses,
  sum(net_expenses) AS total_net_expenses,
  count(*) AS month_count
FROM monthly_expenses
